title: Steam Gardens SMP
description: A chill, private server focused around Create, Aeronautics, and Farmer's Delight.
body:
**NOTE: THIS SERVER IS WHITELIST-ONLY.**

The Steam Gardens SMP is a server focused on Create, Aeronautics, and Farmer's Delight. The modpack will receive semi-regular updates to simply keep mods up-to-date and additional mods may be added every now and then. It's recommended to play with [the 1.21.1 NeoForge port of Voxy](https://github.com/realBritakee/voxy-neoforge), [Voxy Worldgen v2](https://github.com/realBritakee/voxy_worldgen_v2), and any client-side mods you want since this pack only includes the mods required to actually join the server, as well as some performance mods.

To set up, simply install the pack on the Modrinth app, install whichever shaders, resource packs, or client-side mods you wish, change your keybinds and options if necessary, and play!

This pack is primarily focused on Create, Create Aeronautics, and Farmer's Delight. For more information on included mods, see the [server modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/steam-gardens-smp-modpack).

The Steam Gardens SMP is a lightly modded server made for my friend group. The intended experience is to simply build, chat, and chill. We have Create and Aeronautics to make travel between bases easier and more fun, Farmer's Delight to make the culinary experience much better, and MCA Reborn to make towns and families. I frequently stream on the server, so if you want you can watch my livestreams on [my YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/@angelic_aether).
